title: Run to Safety Under the Wings of Your Prophet!
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidi, madad. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah.Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Azeez Allah
Allah.Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah.Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, SubhaanAllah
Allah.Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Sultaan Sensin, Subhaan Sensin!
Zidh habeebika 'izzan wa karaman wa sharafan wa nooran masrooran wa ridhwanan, yaa Rabbi 'l-`Alameen
wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan ila yawmi 'd-deen. Thumma 'salaatu wa 's-salaam `ala jamee`al-anbiya'i w 'almursaleen wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaanin wa `ibaadillahi 's-saaliheen ila yawmi 'd-deen.
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. O our Lord, we are asking forgiveness and blessings! We are
weak servants. Give us more power for defending Islam, the Prophet of Islam, and to call people to Your
servanthood. And according to Your order, we are saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)

Yaa Rabb, yaa Rabb. Thumma salaam `ala Saahib az-Zamaan, w 'as-salaam `ala Qutb az-Zamaan, who is
looking after everything happening on this planet, yes. We must try to give our best regards and our respects
for them because they are representing the Heavenly Kingdom on Earth. If they are not with us, it is going to
be the worst situation for this planet and everything on it! They are protecting Mankind from shaytanic tricks
and traps, and they are trying to wake up people for them not to be heedless, because when a person is
heedless he will quickly fall in shaytanic traps!
O our Attenders! Therefore, we are saying give very sharp attention to what is going to be said to you, as it is
not something from an earthly level, but a little bit up, that if a person is getting in a higher position he may
look with a general overview from the east to the west. Therefore, they are not advising as a person who may
be on the Earth and speaking. You may sit here and your vision covers a very short distance, but when you
are going up, your vision is going to be wider, wider, wider. Therefore, you take much more care. And the
Lord of Heavens may choose from His servants who to send to wake people up, and those He chooses will
never be out of existence. They remain among Mankind, trying to wake up all people as we are in need to
learn what is useful for us, and that will be daleel, a guide for us. The Lord of Heavens is making people learn
for their benefit, because he who is not knowing anything about this life or about Mankind and their mission
is like a blind person who may fall anytime in an unexpected trap.
Shaytan is the most dangerous enemy for Mankind! He puts his traps everywhere, like an enemy army places
mines and their location is hidden or disguised, then suddenly someone may step on it and it explodes,
finishing them. Shaytan plants his traps everywhere, even in unexpected areas where no one knows.
Therefore, Allah Almighty orders believers to have some ones who are experts in understanding Shaytan's
traps and who knows their locations. By yourself it is impossible to know, but you must have such a person
who is expert and he may keep them. Therefore, the Lord of Heavens is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••••••••• •••• ••••••••••••
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanu ittaqullah wa koonu ma` as-saadiqeen. O you who believe! Fear Allah and be
with those who are trustworthy (in word and deed). (9:119)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Everything is given clearly in the Holy Qur'an for every occasion! They are saying, "O
People! Why is Allah Almighty ordering you to be with true ones? Because they know protect you from the

trap for Mankind, as a hen protects her chickens under its wings, from cats and other animals. And therefore,
with everything a believer looks at, he must take an advice, as we know from hadeeth an-Nabi (s), nazharahu
hikmah, "consideration of wisdom;" if a believer is looking at something, he must know something about it or
what is happening, not like a blind person. Therefore, we need to follow someone who knows if there is a
danger for Mankind, and where Shaytan put its traps. We must look for such a person and come under his
wings for protection, here and Hereafter.

SubhaanAllah. Allah Almighty is making everything clear in the Holy Qur'an and in sunnat un-Nabi! The
Sahaabah (r) said, "When the fighting intensified and people feared for their lives, we ran to the Prophet (s)."
Take your lesson from every hadeeth ash-shareef, not only just to read it and pass it on, no. Were those
ahadeeth narrated for nothing? No, it can't be! Every hadith is for teaching ummat al-Habeeb, the Seal of
Prophet's nation, because for every time it is going to be the last period of Mankind on this planet and after it
Judgment Day, Yawm al-Qiyamah, is coming.
O Salafi `ulamas! Say, "O People! That hadeeth ash-shareef was narrated for what? You must do as the
Companions; when they feared, they ran to Prophet (s), because when you arrive under his divinely wings,
you will be in safety! Run to the Prophet (s)!! O People! Are you running?" Why are you not saying this, O
Salafi `ulamas? As-salamu `ala man ittaba` al-huda, (peace be on those who follow the guidance). Why are
you not making it clear for the ummah, for the nation of Sayyidina Muhammad, peace be upon him!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
O Salafi `ulamas! Why are you not making it clear that the safety and the guarantee for your lives, here and
Hereafter, is to run to him, to be under his wings, to be under his holy flag? Where is the Holy Flag of the Seal
of Prophets (s)? Why are you not bringing it out? Why are you not asking where it is? You say you know
everything; then say what does it mean to be under the wings of the Holy Prophet (s)! When the Sahaabah
felt fearful, they ran to Prophet. Why are you not saying to Muslims, and first to the people of Hijaaz, the
people of jazeerat ul-Arab, the Arabian Peninsula? You are Arabs! Why are you not saying? And you are
running, some of you to America, to Russia, to China, to Europe. Why? They say, "We must buy many more
nuclear weapons. Technology of western countries is much more than what Americans have." And the
Russians may say, "Our technology is up, with the technology of America." Why? Why? There is no shelter for
Muslims on this planet! If there is no shelter here, do you think that you will find shelter in the Hereafter?

Why are you not raising the Holy Flag of the Seal of Prophets (s), saying, “This is the flag of the Seal of
Prophets! Come under it and be in safety! The Prophet (s) is saying, 'O People! Run to me and be in safety
here and Hereafter, with me. I am forever the guarantor for the best, highest life, here and Hereafter! Come
to me! This is my flag.'"
O Salafi `ulamas! Why aren't you saying? Wahhabi people are never thinking, so don't mind them as they are
going to be angry; it doesn't matter. For those who are angry there is a holy verse, mootoo bi-ghaythikum,
“Die in your rage.” (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) That is ayatul-kareemah. If you are very angry at true
ones and your heart is full with shaytanic anger, that anger will kill you. It is bad-du'a, a curse! It is not good,
it is bad to go against them. The Lord of Heavens is saying, "If you are not happy with the realities from the
Holy Qur'an, mootoo bi-ghaythikum." To whom is this addressing? You are Salafi `ulamas, say! It is only for
the time of the Seal of Prophets, and after that Allah Almighty is angry with them and saying to them, "You
may die with your dirty anger." ?
Now with the approach of the Last Days, heavenly anger is coming in the material being of people, who are
full with anger up to here, because they are against the holy orders of Shari`atullah, saying, "We don't like the
heavenly rules and will not follow them." They are falling into such a bad condition, and the angels are saying
to them, mootoo bi-ghaythikum, "Die in your rage! Because you left the holy rules of the Heavens and
brought new rules from your bad wishing and egoistic principles, and forced people to follow them, bringing
trouble to them!" If such ones are not followed, they become very angry. In our days, in such a country, some
get very angry because people are leaving their false rules and asking to come under a heavenly flag and
heavenly rules. For them it has been said, mootoo bi-ghaythikum! It means, “You must die with your bad
anger, and find your graveyard full with fire, and when you stand up on the Day of Resurrection, fire will
cover you! You will come through flames, and stand up in your graves consumed by fires of your bad egos!"
O People! That is a heavenly warning to all Mankind! Come and listen to heavenly orders, to be in safety,
because if you are not following heavenly orders, fire, troubles, crises, illness, nonsense beings, heavenly
cursing and fire will follow you and burn you! Now people from east to west are in the worst situation,
because fire from the Earth surrounds them, and also from the Heavens such a fire is coming that burns them
from inside.

O our Attenders! Don't be foolish ones! Come and listen! What has been said is true, Haqq! Follow truth and
you will be happy, here and Hereafter. If you change again and again from truth to falsehood, you will fall
into your grave where fire is burning. Come to Islam, keep Islam, believe in Islam, and live in Islam! Then
you will be happy here and Hereafter; otherwise, you will never find ladhat ul-hayaat (tastiness of this life),
pleasure, here or Hereafter. May Allah forgive us. Tawbah, yaa Rabb.
Fatihah.
(40 minutes) (1018 viewers) Alhamdulillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
